sloka: बालस्त्वमसि सौमित्रे विक्रमेष्वविचक्षणः।गच्छ किं कालसदृशं मां योधयितुमिच्छसि ।। ६.७१.५१ ।।
transliteration: bālastvamasi saumitre vikrameṣvavicakṣaṇaḥ।gaccha kiṁ kālasadṛśaṁ māṁ yodhayitumicchasi ।। 6.71.51 ।।

translations.english: "O Saumithri! You are valiant but young, not able to discriminate. I am equal to the Lord of death. Why do you desire to comb at with me?"
